summary: Frontend-only regression testing for retail cart improvements (8 items). All 8 requested features verified working end-to-end: initial no-qty-controls state, add-to-cart replaces button with qty controls + shows in-cart badge + navbar badge, live badge updates, decrement to 0 reverts to Add-to-Cart button + hides badge, floating cart appears on scroll on /products with correct count/total and opens drawer, floating cart hidden on /products/:id and /wholesale, checkout delivery-info-box present with correct text (Alija Kotla, 3 km, ₹50, Free Delivery), WhatsApp URL includes the delivery note, home page shows new location text and google-maps link points to Alija+Kotla+Charminar+Hyderabad.
